issues.issue: The endpoint text claims the ALSFRS-R slope was measured 'over the 24-week study period', but the cited quote only says 'the rate of decline (slope) of the total ALSFRS-R score' without the 24-week qualifier.

The text states the September 7, 2022 committee 'voted 7-2 ... in favor of approval', but the cited quote (YES: 7 NO: 2) does not state the question voted on was approval; the citation does not support the 'in favor of approval' characterization.

The summary characterizes the 7-2 reconvened vote as 'in favor of approval', which is not supported by the cited quote stating only the vote tally; same unsupported inference as in advisory_committee.vote.

The survival result narrative reports 'median 23.5 vs 18.7 months', but omits/reframes the review's stated 4.8-month difference; minor but the paired median framing is supported so this is borderline.
